تستأنفون (form X)
# تَسْتَأْنِفُونَ (tastaʔnifūna) /tas.taʔ.ni.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
# تُسْتَأْنَفُونَ (tustaʔnafūna) /tus.taʔ.na.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَفَ (istaʔnafa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
